d.ko:
부자가 되던지 땅파다 죽으세요!

광산을 헤쳐나가며 보물을 발굴하고 지하 깊은 곳에 어떤 위대한 신비가 있는지 발견하세요!
d.en: Explore the depths of the earth and uncover hidden treasures in this addictive idle mining game. Unlock the power of your drill with hundreds of upgrades, discover mysterious relics, and unearth priceless gems. Can you master the mines and reveal their deepest secrets? Dive in and dig deep!
d.zh: 在矿井中四处溜达，发现地下深处的奥秘和宝藏。
